entities.name: Cristóbal Rojas Sandoval
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Cristóbal Rojas Sandoval was a Roman Catholic prelate who served as Archbishop of Seville (1571–1580), 
Bishop of Córdoba (1562–1571),
Bishop of Badajoz (1556–1562),
and Bishop of Oviedo (1546–1556).
